verdicts.reason: Both break the parallel structure of the two couplets. 'When Life Is Rough / PRAY' is stacked with a big gap, while 'When Life Is Great PRAY' sits inline at a different PRAY size. Both also put a hard-cropped rectangular rose in a corner, and the type is small, leaving lots of dead white space. In A the divider almost touches the end of 'Rough' and the left group feels jammed. B spaces the divider a little more evenly between the two groups, so it is marginally less awkward.
